{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check which rows have missing 'sex' and whether they also have missing 'flipper_length_mm'
missing_sex_rows = df[df['sex'].isnull()]

# Check if any of these rows have missing flipper_length_mm
missing_sex_and_flipper = missing_sex_rows[missing_sex_rows['flipper_length_mm'].isnull()]

# Output the result
missing_sex_and_flipper"}
